galatians.1.p1.b1.text: Paul, an apostle—sent not from men nor by man, but by Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised Him from the dead—

galatians.1.p1.b2.text: and all the brothers with me, To the churches of Galatia:

galatians.1.p1.b3.text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,

galatians.1.p2.b1.text: I am amazed how quickly you are deserting the One who called you by the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel—

galatians.1.p2.b2.text: which is not even a gospel.

galatians.1.p2.b3.text: Evidently some people are troubling you and trying to distort the gospel of Christ.

galatians.1.p3.b1.text: But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach a gospel contrary to the one we preached to you, let him be under a curse!

galatians.1.p3.b2.text: If anyone is preaching to you a gospel contrary to the one you received, let him be under a curse!

galatians.1.p3.b3.text: Am I now seeking the approval of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men?

galatians.1.p4.b1.text: For I certify to you, brothers, that the gospel I preached was not devised by man. … rather, I received it by revelation from Jesus Christ.

galatians.1.p4.b2.text: For you have heard of my former way of life in Judaism, how severely I persecuted the church of God and tried to destroy it.

galatians.1.p4.b3.text: I was advancing in Judaism beyond many of my contemporaries and was extremely zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

galatians.1.p5.b1.text: But when God, who set me apart from my mother’s womb and called me by His grace, was pleased to reveal His Son in me so that I might preach Him among the Gentiles,

galatians.1.p5.b2.text: I did not rush to consult with flesh and blood,

galatians.1.p5.b3.text: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to the apostles who came before me, but I went into Arabia and later returned to Damascus.

galatians.1.p6.b1.text: Only after three years did I go up to Jerusalem to confer with Cephas, and I stayed with him fifteen days.

galatians.1.p6.b2.text: But I saw none of the other apostles except James, the Lord’s brother.

galatians.1.p6.b3.text: I assure you before God that what I am writing to you is no lie.

galatians.1.p7.b1.text: Later I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

galatians.1.p7.b2.text: I was personally unknown, however, to the churches of Judea that are in Christ.

galatians.1.p7.b3.text: “The man who formerly persecuted us is now preaching the faith he once tried to destroy.”

galatians.1.p7.b4.text: And they glorified God because of me.
